correctness.rationale: Jacobian rank singles out eight triple intersections, each with 32 projective sign lifts. The parity-mode argument reduces the degree-by-degree evaluation map to rational matrices which the package checker exhaustively reconstructs and row-reduces in degrees 0–5. originality.rationale: The actual scientific new claim is the exact graded postulation of the reduced 256 singular points, its two additional cubic classes, and its six-regular point ideal. The primary papers supply the ambient surface and nodes but not the graded ranks. Relevant prior same-surface public results address conics and incidence instead; exhaustive finite character-block computation supplies the missing arithmetic. Priority remains provisional because differently indexed past computations may exist.

value.rationale: The set of 256 A1 nodes is a canonical finite configuration of a widely studied complete-intersection surface. Its first arbitrary interpolation degree, its graded Hilbert function and its new cubic equations are intrinsic and usable in studies of hypersurfaces with prescribed conditions at the singularities; the character-block method has explanatory structural content beyond a numerical table.
